exposure: Presence of uterine niche (cesarean section scar defect)
cohort: Women with uterine niches (n=8) and without niche formation (n=5)
finding: Uterine niches frequently exhibit endocervical mucosa, often cystically dilated, and/or an atrophic or disorganized endometrial mucosa, regenerative epithelial atypia, and fibroblastic stromal reaction.
